user.title: QQBot Notify
user.description: Fill in the AppID and AppSecret of your QQ open platform bot. The default recipient (OpenID) is optional.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the QQ open platform, please try again
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log

init.title: QQBot Notify options
init.description: The default recipient can be changed at any time. Leave it empty to remove it.

send.name: Send message
send.description: Send a QQ message to a user or group through the QQ bot, optionally overriding the default recipient.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title, sent as the first line of the message.

target.name: Recipient
target.description: user_openid or group_openid. Falls back to the default recipient of the config entry.

is_group.name: Group message
is_group.description: Send through the group API (target is a group_openid).

msg_id.name: Reply to msg_id
msg_id.description: Optional msg_id for a passive reply, taken from a QQ message event.

msg_seq.name: Reply sequence
msg_seq.description: Reply number for the same msg_id, starting at 1.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Select which bot to use when several QQ bots are configured.
